transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Common Sense Media says ChatGPT for Teens is an unacceptable risk due to flawed safety alerts, confirmed by The Verge.
Mistral unveils a trillion-parameter model, claiming cyber and artificial intelligence leadership over Chinese and closed systems, confirmed by Brussels Signal.
HP leaks RTX Spark laptop prices starting at $2,999.99 for the 14-inch model, still open per Notebookcheck.
OpenAI shares 372 artificial intelligence-generated math proofs on GitHub, advancing open problems with formal verification, confirmed by The Decoder.
Anthropic expands artificial intelligence testing access and finds 129,000 vulnerabilities, with 44 percent of artificial intelligence-generated code introducing security risks, confirmed by The Hacker News.
Free every hour.
